items.source: Implementations can be created via the static factory methods forInstanceOf(Class, BiConsumer) or forType(Class, BiConsumer). Below is a simple but complete Validator that validates that the various String properties of a UserLogin instance are not empty (they are not null and do not consist wholly of whitespace), and that any password that is present is at least 'MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH' characters in length.
items.translation: 可以通过静态工厂方法 forInstanceOf(Class, BiConsumer) 或 forType(Class, BiConsumer) 创建实现。 下面是一个简单但完整的 Validator，它验证 UserLogin 实例的各种 String 属性不为空（即不为 null 且不全由空白字符组成），并且如果存在密码，其长度至少为 'MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH' 个字符。

items.source: Note: This validation call comes with limitations in the Errors implementation used, in particular no support for nested paths. If this is insufficient for your purposes, call the regular validate(Object, Errors) method with a binding-capable Errors implementation such as BeanPropertyBindingResult.
items.translation: 注意：此验证调用受所使用的Errors实现中的限制，特别是它不支持嵌套路径。如果这无法满足您的需求，请调用常规的validate(Object, Errors)方法，并使用具有绑定功能的Errors实现，例如BeanPropertyBindingResult。

items.source: Delegates to the common validate(Object, Errors) method. The returned errors instance can be used to report any resulting validation errors for the specific target object, for example, if (validator.validateObject(target).hasErrors()) ... or validator.validateObject(target).failOnError(IllegalStateException::new));.
items.translation: 委托给公共的 validate(Object, Errors) 方法。返回的 errors 实例可用于报告特定目标对象产生的任何验证错误，例如： if (validator.validateObject(target).hasErrors()) ... 或 validator.validateObject(target).failOnError(IllegalStateException::new));。

items.source: The supplied errors instance can be used to report any resulting validation errors, typically as part of a larger binding process which this validator is meant to participate in. Binding errors have typically been pre-registered with the errors instance before this invocation already.
items.translation: 提供的 errors 实例可用于报告任何由此产生的验证错误，通常作为此验证器旨在参与的更大绑定过程的一部分。绑定错误通常在此调用之前已经预先注册到 errors 实例中。

items.source:
This interface is totally divorced from any infrastructure
or context; that is to say it is not coupled to validating
only objects in the web tier, the data-access tier, or the
whatever-tier. As such it is amenable to being used in any layer
of an application, and supports the encapsulation of validation
logic as a first-class citizen in its own right.
items.translation: 该接口与任何基础设施或上下文完全解耦；也就是说，它不与仅存在于 Web 层、数据访问层或其他任意层的验证对象耦合。因此，它适用于应用程序的任何层，并将验证逻辑作为一等公民进行封装。

items.source: Validate the given target object which must be of a Class for which the supports(Class) method typically has returned (or would return) true.
items.translation: 验证给定的target对象，该对象必须是Class类型，且其supports(Class)方法通常已返回（或将会返回）true。

items.source: Return a Validator that checks whether the target object's class is identical to targetClass, applying the given delegate to populate Errors if it is.
items.translation: 返回一个 `Validator`，用于检查目标对象的类是否与 `targetClass` 相同；如果不同，则应用给定的 `delegate` 来填充 Errors。
